integrity: Exact all-size proof, self-contained polynomial root argument, and standalone standard-library enumeration verifier; computational checks are corroborative and do not constitute independent validation or a publication-priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Independent-edge component-reach only; one seed; all clique sizes at least four have at least two optimality reversals, while exact two-switch uniqueness is proved only for the nine-vertex case; priority uncertainty includes a 2013 epidemic-centrality study whose full text was inaccessible.
title: Re-entrant single-seed influence on a clique–star bridge
